mapper.select: SELECT sm.id, sm.sub_menu_name as name, sm.sub_menu_redirect as url, FROM sub_menu as sm WHERE sm.sub_menu_status = 1 && sm.main_menu_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sub_menu (sub_menu_name, sub_menu_desc, sub_menu_status, sub_menu_redirect) VALUES (#{sub_menu_name}, #{sub_menu_desc}, #{sub_menu_status}, #{sub_menu_redirect})
